## {data-title="Fault 1: readable" data-section="Pictures"}

::: notes
This deck is an internal regression fixture for picture rendering. It deliberately repeats aspect ratios, wrappers and labels to test their combinations. For ordinary author examples, use [picture patterns](https://rahuldave.com/htmpres/patterns.html).
:::
